title: Full-field and Bloch-periodic-factor discretizations: Accuracy and phantom modes
summary: One can distinguish four major formulations of the Bloch-mode problem in linear periodic media. First, there are two common complementary ways of slicing the Bloch variety (Bloch wave vectors paired with the corresponding frequencies): frequency vs. wave vector or, conversely, wave vector vs. frequency. This paper deals exclusively with the latter option, directly applicable to lossy media, evanescent waves, and complex band structures.
